description: Services ensure the administrative, logistical, medical, equipment upkeep, and legal sustainment of the Indian Army in peace and war.

items.name: Army Service Corps (ASC)
items.motto: Seva Asmakam Dharma (Service is Our Duty)
items.role: Rations, petroleum/oil/lubricants (POL), transport logistics, and air-drop supplies.
items.details: Responsible for feeding, fueling, and transporting troops across peacetime stations and war zones.

items.name: Army Ordnance Corps (AOC)
items.role: Logistical supply of arms, ammunition, vehicles, clothing, and military equipment.
items.details: Manages central ammunition depots and inventory management for millions of inventory items.

items.name: Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers (EME)
items.role: Repair, maintenance, recovery, and engineering support for all electrical, mechanical, and electronic equipment.
items.details: Ensures tanks, radar systems, field weapons, and vehicles remain operational on the battlefield.

items.name: Army Medical Corps (AMC)
items.motto: Sarve Santu Niramaya (May All Be Free From Disease)
items.role: Comprehensive healthcare, combat casualty treatment, military hospitals, and combat field ambulances.
items.details: Provides medical care to serving personnel, veterans, and military dependents.

items.name: Remount and Veterinary Corps (RVC)
items.motto: Seva Anusandhan Pashu Raksha (Service and Protection of Animals)
items.role: Breeding, training, and healthcare of army dogs, mules, and horses used in high-altitude logistics and counter-insurgency.
items.details: RVC canine and pack-animal units are vital for mountain logistics in the Himalayas.

items.name: Army Educational Corps (AEC)
items.role: Educational training, language instruction, map reading, and military promotional examinations.
items.details: Facilitates ongoing education and foreign language training for army personnel.

items.name: Corps of Military Police (CMP)
items.role: Traffic control, prisoner of war management, crime prevention, and maintaining discipline.
items.details: Recognized by their distinct white helmets, lanyards, and red armbands.

items.name: Judge Advocate General's Department (JAG)
items.role: Legal advice, court-martial proceedings, and military legal administration.
items.details: Legal branch of the Army headed by the Judge Advocate General.
